context_requirements: Expression of BCR-ABL1 fusion protein (Philadelphia chromosome) or dependence on wild-type ABL1 kinase activity
BCR-ABL-positive hematopoietic lineage (CML or Ph+ ALL); none of the nine profiled lines are BCR-ABL-positive leukemias
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine BCR-ABL-negative lines
Selective modulation of ABL1 target genes or BCR-ABL downstream signatures (e.g., STAT5, CRKL) in these lines

evidence.supports: Bcr-Abl kinase inhibitors act on BCR-ABL and its mutants in leukemic cells; activity is restricted to Bcr-Abl-expressing contexts
Bcr-Abl inhibition inactivates Bcr/Abl and downstream STAT5/CRKL in BCR/ABL+ leukemia cells
Bcr-Abl inhibitors induce apoptosis/autophagy in Bcr-Abl-positive leukemia cell lines
STI571 effects are mediated through Bcr-abl in K562 CML cells
